tasks.label: Build GBE
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && rgbasm -o build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.asm && rgblink -m build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.sym -o build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.gb build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o && rgbfix -v -p 0xFF build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.gb
